main_text.p: dem Gemara (ad tit Megillah cap. r. Fol. 70. a[?] Hal. 6.) Sepius ex Gemaricorum usu[?], ut multum tum pronunciatur. Unde illud R. Jacob Bar Asher[?] בטל יום טיריון Tiriam dies abstinenti[?] qui Batelo[?]nisi autem Gemarae כנירית תיניירת[?] alias tit. Thaanith cap. 2. fol. 171. [illegible, ~6 letters] tera recensét, non semel citamus: inoleverat enim antiquitus, ut in Hierosolymitana occurrit, diem[?] Hebraeos frequentissime initiuisse festos ob eminentia praecellentes & mirande à lumine [illegible, ~6 letters], quos postmodum pari authoritate in numerum tractiorem[?], ut in calendariis redegerunt. Sed sententiae interim apud Hebraeos [illegible, ~8 letters] servandis praetermittendisve festorum illorum, quae ex jure superinducto, nec ex legitima observatione, ut valere ei maxime in [illegible, ~4 letters] Hierosolymitanus superius memoravit. Ea sane dictos codicem illum, quo impressi unquam, ita ipsum Megillam, sed ejusdem explicationem subiecta. Hactenus Seldenus, atque haec ad notitiam festorum ex quibus concludimus & testimonium authoritatem[?] ratum, & Herodem mortuum fuisse anno Jul. [illegible, ~3 letters], die mensis Cislev[?] vii, sed iuxta calendarium Romanum xxv Novembris, quod nobis erat demonstrandum.

page.notes: Printer's quotation marks in the left margin are not transcribed. Many words are uncertain because the scan is faint and show-through is present; [?] marks these. Hebrew strings in the running text are copied as far as legible and may contain errors. The mark "T E H." at lower right is recorded as a signature, but its function is uncertain. The "alias" fragment at the right of the Hebrew line is too faint to read and is not transcribed.
